indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Ended a three-day losing streak as chipmakers bounced back.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Led the gains on a rebound in AI and semiconductor stocks.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Slipped as Apple and Sherwin-Williams fell, despite a strong day for Microsoft.

notes: Chip stocks recovered after Monday's sell-off: Nvidia rose about 2%, AMD about 4% ahead of its results, and Microsoft gained close to 3%.
Apple dropped about 2% on worries about slower services growth and thinner margins, and Palantir fell despite beating forecasts as investors focused on slower US commercial bookings.
Eaton jumped about 7% on strong results tied to data-centre power demand; oil was roughly flat with WTI near $96.5, and the 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 4.96%.
events: Wed 4 Nov: US midterm election results come in through the Kuwait morning; markets react to AMD's after-hours results.
Fri 6 Nov, 16:30 Kuwait time: US October jobs report.
